result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active unmatched contributors.

**Change:** one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java` (line 747). An unmatched contributor joins the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped entirely.

- Blank latest-commit dates count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank input. No extra handling was needed.
- Configured teams are untouched. Their members are still added before this check, so active or not.

**Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test` ran with no failures or build errors. No existing tests cover this class, so I did not add a test for the new behaviour. Nothing is committed.
